title: How Swing Model Assumptions Shape Vote-to-Seat Predictions
authors: Cornelius Erfort, Lukas F. Stoetzer, and Thomas Gschwend. Under review at Electoral Studies.
abstract: Forecasters map national trends to district seats via swing rules, but little is known about modelling choices. Using eight German federal elections and simulations, we compare uniform and proportional swing (and variants): differences are modest yet affect precision; uniform swing improves when national swings are larger, district volatility lower, and more parties compete.
